data.narrative:
Percepto is a Series C-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $128M to date. The comparable universe consists of seven private peers in the sector, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro, with no public comps available for direct benchmarking.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised of $128M as a baseline valuation proxy, we apply a typical Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x, yielding an implied post-money valuation of $218M. A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable data points within the narrow Drones & Autonomous peer set—only two adjacent-stage comps were identified, below the three-datapoint threshold required for statistical reliability.

The triangulated valuation range derived from this single-method analysis is $185M (low) to $250M (high), with a median of $218M. This range reflects reasonable sensitivity bounds around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the limited comparability universe (seven private peers, zero public benchmarks) and reliance on a single valuation method. Resolution of these uncertainties would require either identification of additional same-stage comparable transactions or forward-looking financial data on burn rate, revenue trajectory, and path to profitability for peer validation.
